answer: Pay each agent across a delayed horizon: rewards settle as shale-like layers of escrow that only harden after 30 epochs of peer-graded work. If an audit links an identity to a Sybil cluster, every unhardened layer is clawed back and paid to the honest graders who flagged it. The delta between instant and delayed pay is the attacker's cost: a farm of 1,000 fakes must fund 30 epochs of real compute per identity before earning anything, and loses all of it on one detection.
